quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs show construction areas. Drive carefully and be alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Slow down to a safe speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that pedestrians may cross ahead. Stop and wait if a pedestrian is crossing in the marked crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that a divided highway begins ahead.

questions.question: When you see an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means "Stop." Come to a complete stop, yield to traffic and pedestrians, and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on the back of vehicles moving slower than 25 mph, such as farm equipment or horse-drawn carriages.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming so you can prepare to turn or watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn you to slow down, be careful, and watch for children in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells you U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging onto the road from the right. Be prepared to allow vehicles to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you that you must drive in the direction the arrow points. It marks a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. Only vehicles with disability license plates or placards may park in these spaces.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red traffic light. You must stop and wait for a signal that allows you to turn in that direction.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep your regular speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, and slow down. Be ready to stop. Let trains pass before you go.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. This includes farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You may see it at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down. Road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. Road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow to 35 mph or slower for the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow to 35 mph or slower for the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. A speed plaque with this sign tells you the safe speed for the curve.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns you that traffic is merging ahead.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about special conditions or hazards ahead. They are yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming right curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign always means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill or downgrade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep hill or downgrade ahead. The hill may be very long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, you should:
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings tells you that a divided highway is starting. Keep to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Slow down and yield to other traffic.
Other vehicles may enter the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely, let all crossing traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns of a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows that the road ahead:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see all directions.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching railroad tracks and should be ready to stop.
Will always stop at the railroad crossing.
Must stop and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching railroad tracks and should be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you are approaching a railroad crossing. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: How far above the road a bridge or overpass is.
The tallest vehicle allowed in this state.
The widest vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: How far above the road a bridge or overpass is.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the height from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this example, the clearance is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions just ahead. This sign tells you the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve to the right first, then to the left. Slow down and be ready to adjust your steering.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: The light is about to turn red.
The light is about to turn green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light is about to turn red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns you that the signal will change to red soon. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection, continue through.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, what does it mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right because of construction.
The road ahead turns sharply at a steep angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply at a steep angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions just ahead. This sign tells you to slow down because the road will change direction suddenly and sharply.

questions.question: What does this road sign tell you?

options.text: A school zone is near or ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A school zone is near or ahead.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mark school zones and school crossings. Watch for children and drive at the posted speed limit when near a school.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people in your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign alerts you that road work is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices when driving through a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange color is used for warning signs in construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You might see it if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic merging into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic merging into your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right into your lane. Be prepared to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you that you may lose control of your vehicle. Slow down when you see wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: A round sign warns of a railroad crossing. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway. You will soon be on a highway with traffic moving in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn of conditions immediately ahead. This sign means you are leaving a one-way highway and will soon drive on a two-way highway with traffic in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road ahead will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of upcoming hazards. Round signs are used only to warn of railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves at slow speeds. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks like a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic lights?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic lights are coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a black symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you before you go. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangular sign is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see a yield sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. These signs alert drivers to areas where bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until the way is clear and you can safely pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests, yellow-green shirts, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic and let workers or construction vehicles cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange is the standard color for work zone activity. If you see orange signs, cones, or barrels, stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is coming and you must obey their directions.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop. Look in all directions for traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They warn you about road conditions ahead. This sign tells you a divided roadway is coming.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are near a school or school crossing. Be alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Get ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn you about animals, people, and vehicles that might cross your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a side road is coming up ahead. Stay alert.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. You must obey it. It means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black lettering. It warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This sign warns of what?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you of a steep hill coming up. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign warns of what?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: This is a yield sign. You must slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass before you go. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: You see this sign at a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to drive faster than an oncoming train.

questions.question: What does this yellow pennant-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped yellow signs indicate a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely. Only go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Only go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must stop completely, check for traffic and pedestrians, and go only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
Traffic is merging from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side. Move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Side road entering from the left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Start slowing down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane ends soon. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends soon. Merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means the number of lanes is decreasing and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings or symbols. They give important information about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead will be slippery.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It has white background with red and black markings. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves or gets narrower ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves or gets narrower ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve or get narrower. You may see this sign on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a crossroad is ahead.
